text: In this unit Lena takes Alex to breakfast at a Berlin café, and Alex orders a drink and a roll in German for the first time. In this unit you will order a coffee or a meal, ask what is on the menu, say what you cannot eat, reserve a table and pay the bill. The scenes are set in places you may know: a café counter, the university canteen, a restaurant, a pub and a friend's kitchen.
Listen to the dialogues first, then work through the other sections in any order.
